body:
Track 11, milestone 3 (`mimic-crossplay`). Scores every imitator prompt from the `mimic-loop` runs against every detector prompt (Qwen2.5-0.5B on both sides, 48 titles per cell) and solves the zero-sum matrix game per family.

- reddit 10x7 and reviews 9x10 payoff matrices; both have a pure equilibrium with Nash value below chance (0.396 and 0.292).
- No reversals at a 0.15 noise margin; overfitting to the latest opponent is small and not established.
- Mean text length tracks detector accuracy (Spearman 0.76 reddit, 0.30 reviews).
- The model-size half of the milestone is not run (stated in the README).
- 12 tests, `python site/build.py` prints ok, README bullet and `site/projects.json` entry added, run record in `prompts/runs.jsonl`.
